title: Use Ollama as an OpenAI API in Python: Swap One URL
description:
Swap one URL and your code talks to a local model. ⚡

✅ Set base_url to Ollama on localhost:11434/v1
✅ The api_key is required, but any text works
✅ Name the model you pulled and run it

Day 5 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 6, Shrink a Model with Quantization.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

comment: Python or Node: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the api_key must be set, but Ollama ignores its value, so any text works.
